note: A desktop .ork now opens on the Earth model it names - Flat Earth, Spherical Earth or the WGS84 ellipsoid - and Launch conditions has a Geodetic calculations selector for it; 7 of desktop OpenRocket's own examples name Flat Earth and now land up to 3.4 m from where they did, with apogee within 6 cm. The AeroTech K62N's length is corrected from 274 mm to 374.25 mm, from its certification letter and the NAR's certified list; re-open the design's file, or pick the motor again in each flight configuration that flies it (a RASAero file that states its CG has to be re-opened). A solid body tube now has no bore anywhere in the app, closing what v0.147's notes left undone, and a RASAero save now refuses a tail cone in a pod set or strap-on instead of dropping it. Labels across Preferences and the motor card now reach their controls when clicked, and the Scale dialog's motor-mount list now has a name. Two more lint rules are on, and the engine package no longer ships its tests.
